# f45: the owner's look at 45 (no diagnostic switch beyond the kit's defaults): is play smooth and even, are goals, celebrations and replays (at 30) clean at the cut, does it ever flap between 45 and 30. The `[f45]` lines still say what happened. Pass rule: the log has `[f45] 45 cadence on` and `[f45] 300 pictures` lines (INVALID without). In live play: `off the pattern 0`; `[present]` held 1/2/3+ about 2 : 1 : 0; pattern slips under 8 % of the 45 pictures (late + held to a later predicted slot); interpolation error: pictures off their show vblank only behind slips (mean under 0.05 refreshes); no FALLBACK line at Vice; at most one fallback per match and never back and forth; `[speed]` 98 % or better; `[lat]` pad->shown p50 within 10 ms of the 30 FPS run (d30). Held scenes at 30 as in d30.
